statements.statement: CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for the patient
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42)
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The monitoring was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to symptomatic episodes
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
